title: Author(s) (Year): Short title
citation: journal, volume(pages), doi or URL - where the study itself lives
materials: what you ACTUALLY held and read - be honest; every grade below is conditioned on this
decision_context: what the assessment is FOR; UNDECLARED if none - then downstream implications must be conditional, never recommendations

design_checks.finding: what the check found, verbatim where possible
design_checks.source: URL or location of the finding

claims.text: VERBATIM claim text - quote, do not paraphrase
claims.label: UNDECLARED
claims.measurand: what was measured, not what it is called
claims.instrument: the exact task/assay/scaffold that produced the number - the datum
claims.falsifiers: what would have to be observed for the claim to be wrong, and whether the publication reports testing it
claims.source: URL or location backing this claim record

averages.text: what is averaged (a prevalence, base rate, mean effect, typical value) that enters a claim as an input
averages.stationarity_basis: required if ASSESSED - what shows the population did not change
averages.fitted_to: if the value was chosen to reproduce an observed result, name it
averages.estimated_from: the population the value was estimated from, if different from where it is used

tools.output: the finding, with its source location
tools.declined_reason: required if DECLINED - a decline is the headline, not a gap; a gate may block scoring, never reading

decisions.text: the decision surface the reader's decision actually turns on
decisions.answer: only via the resolve command - RESOLVED requires answer AND by (no silent resolution)
decisions.deferred_reason: required if DEFERRED - owned, with reason

_field_guide.pub_type: EMPIRICAL | REVIEW | THEORETICAL | SIMULATION | COMMENTARY | UNDECLARED
_field_guide.claim.support: SUPPORTED | PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED | UNSUPPORTED | CONTRADICTED | UNTESTED | UNDETERMINED
_field_guide.claim.label: OBSERVED | DERIVED | PROPOSED | UNDECLARED
_field_guide.claim.grade: MEASURED_PRESENT | MEASURED_ABSENT | MEASURED_DISCARDED | UNMEASURED | UNDERPOWERED | IMPOSED | UNDECLARED
_field_guide.source fields: recorded provenance (where you say it came from), not verified provenance
_field_guide.average.stationarity: ASSESSED | ASSUMED | UNASSESSED | UNDECLARED (population, window, stationarity all unstated = FROZEN; claims resting on a FROZEN average cannot be MEASURED_*)
